changes: packages/main/src/core/host-run.ts: the codex host_run streaming runner retains a SECOND bounded lane (last turn.failed / terminal error line; same 1MiB last-one-wins UsageLineScanner cap) via failureLineRetainerFor / HostRunSpawnPlan.retainFailureLine / HostRunSpawnResult.failureText, with failureRetentionTruncated honoring the lane's own truncation flag (a candidate-then-over-cap-drop degrades honestly to the generic fallback, mirroring F-013/F-026); new scanCodexTurnFailed + codexTurnFailedReason render turn_failed(<digest>) — innermost error.message drilled from a JSON-encoded body (depth cap 4), control chars/whitespace collapsed, parens neutralized to brackets (delimiter-injection proof), 160-char cap with trailing ellipsis, no_error_message token when unextractable; recordFinalForHost consults the failure lane ONLY when no turn.completed usage exists and falls back to no_turn_completed_usage_event when neither event is present or the failure lane is truncation-poisoned; provider-reported path, F-013/F-026 priority, claude/agy paths and the ledger schema unchanged. packages/main/src/tasks/host-run-usage-smoke.ts: pinned byte-exact B-3928 fixture + 9 new checks (pinned end-to-end row, noise-only fallback, usage precedence, streaming lane via real child, terminal error, digest hygiene incl. paren injection, candidate-then-drop degrade, drop-then-candidate F-026 mirror); existing turn.failed check now expects turn_failed(boom); 74/74 checks pass.
usage: No new flags: run lattice host_run --host codex --agentType <type> [--storyId ...] --prompt ... as before (works with --format json too). When codex fails without a turn.completed usage event, the CLI usage summary and the usage-ledger unavailable final now carry reason turn_failed(<short digest of the codex error message>) — e.g. turn_failed(The 'gpt-5.6-sol' model requires a newer version of Codex. Please upgrade to the latest app or CLI and try again.) — instead of only no_turn_completed_usage_event; the generic reason remains for streams with neither event or a truncation-poisoned failure lane.

Full verbatim transcripts + diff in .lattice/story/actives/B-3ddc/evidence/transcript-diff.md, including the baseline contrast: the installed pre-change CLI with the same shim records only no_turn_completed_usage_event.
outcomeDiff: No difference: actual matched expected on every field in both runs (reason text byte-exact, exit propagation, null counts, ledger rows). Baseline contrast documented the removed failure mode.
limitations: Codex-only enrichment by design (claude/agy failure surfaces out of scope per the user request); the failure lane is best-effort diagnostics — an over-cap (>1MiB) failure line, or a candidate poisoned by a LATER over-cap drop (failureRetentionTruncated), degrades to the generic no_turn_completed_usage_event fallback; usage-lane truncation (usage_line_retention_truncated) deliberately outranks turn_failed; in a single REAL stream the usage-lane flag masks most failure-lane truncation cases (the failure-lane flag is defense-in-depth for injected runners and future refactors).
pitfalls: (1) ProofStory DEV intent gate (enforce) blocked story_advance until original_intent_snapshot_set + intent_collision_set + proofstory_contract_set (verificationIntentRefs MUST use CHK-xxx:lane:index format) + red_evidence_create (target the AB-id, not a CHK-id) were recorded. (2) Scope gate fails closed on ProofStory metadata files not in the lifecycle registry — scope_contract_acknowledge, two rounds as artifacts appear incrementally. (3) scope_contract_init_from_plan yields an EMPTY enforce contract for legacy checklists without files fields — scope_contract_set explicitly right after. (4) Worktree build order: packages/main before packages/utils; symlink main-repo node_modules first. (5) Story-level concept-reviewer dispatch requires reviewer_batch; review_pass_set needs the fully-qualified reviewRunId. (6) A REAL codex exec review round (bounded perl-alarm watchdog, --skip-git-repo-check, stdin </dev/null) caught 2 genuine findings claude-side review missed (stale failure-lane retention after over-cap drop; paren delimiter injection) — recorded as an honest FAIL verdict B-3ddc-local-r1, which escalates the review assurance floor to 3 local rounds. (7) A reviewer running pre-fix load-bearing experiments in the SHARED worktree caused a transient dirty tree during a sibling review — restored before recording; prefer isolated clones for such experiments.
